system.description:
Undeath to Death

Necromancy
Level:
Cleric 6, Sorcerer/Wizard 6
Components:
V, S, M/DF
Area:
Several undead creatures within a 40-ft. -radius burst
Saving Throw:
Will negates

This spell functions like circle of death, except that it destroys undead creatures as noted above.

Material Component: The powder of a crushed diamond worth at least 500 gp.
